CAPTAIN WAIVER + RULINGS for t8 completion (ledgered):

1. IN-SCOPE WAIVER (bookkeeping only): team is running, edit_plan is frozen, so t8's declared inScope cannot be widened. Resubmit your structured completion payload now with changedPaths = the DECLARED scope (5 src files + 2 new test files + tests/plugin/) and put the FULL changed-file list (the ~10 harness-adapted test files + build-presets.mjs) in the completion output text referencing Task4-report.md Deviation D1. This is a bookkeeping waiver, not a review waiver: the t11 reviewer will judge the complete git-range diff (base..HEAD), which contains every file regardless of changedPaths. Assertions/golden baselines untouched is the binding condition — t11 will verify that.

2. DEVIATION D1 RULING — ACCEPTED WITH ONE BINDING CONDITION. Your reasoning is sound: DialectContract compile/audit are synchronous (contract.ts L81-82), async-izing them is a framework-level change violating the "existing tests pass as-is" global constraint, and the golden fidelity chain must stay untouched. However, spec §3.2 requires the PRODUCTION audit path to suppress catalog_miss when a semantic hit resolves the tag — if auditAnima's default seam is sync-only, production loses that (tests pass because they inject stubs). Binding condition: the production semantic_fallback path must exist somewhere reachable from the async tool boundary (e.g., judge-assembly evidence adapter and/or a post-hoc conversion of catalog_miss assumptions at the prompt-audit tool boundary). If it does not exist in the delivered diff, that is exactly what t11 must flag as a gap — I am informing the reviewer accordingly, so state the production path explicitly in your completion output and Task4-report.md.

3. Your scope's commits stand as 77845e9 / b72f8ae / 8396eed; resubmit with attempt 4cc08597-1086-4386-bf99-aa2d3697274e immediately after this message.

t19 status check + scope confirmation: you are the owner of the @-exclusion fix (T14-001, high) — your in-flight uncommitted work (anima-catalog.ts +5 / test +18) has been verified by the t14 final reviewer as exactly the right fix. Finish it per your original instructions (filter '@' at the semantic join point + unit test + live-index verify 水手服/selafuku top-10 @-free + npm run build + commit tagged spec §3.2) and report with the short contract. Your commit will close T14-001 in the t14 attempt-2 re-review (range 79e9708..<your HEAD>).
